definitions.explanation: Honorific form of {知|し}っている, used when politely asking if someone knows something or stating that someone (respected) knows something.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ご{存|ぞん}じ⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.notes: Polite way to ask if someone knows something

examples.japanese: ご{存|ぞん}じ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}します→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧。
examples.english: As you know, I'm moving next month.
examples.notes: Common phrase: ご存じのように

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧ご{存|ぞん}じだ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}います→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I think the teacher already knows.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ご{存|ぞん}じ⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Do you know about this company?

examples.japanese: ご{存|ぞん}じ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧、⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{休業|きゅうぎょう}→休業：11541_kyuugyou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なります→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: As you know, we will be closed next week.

notes:
ご{存|ぞん}じ is the honorific (⟦{尊敬語|そんけいご}→尊敬語：17106_sonkeigo⟧) form of ⟦{知|し}っている→知る：00458_shiru⟧ (to know). Used when asking or stating whether a respected person knows something.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ご{存|ぞん}じ⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: Do you know? (polite)
- ご{存|ぞん}じ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ように→ように：10081_youni⟧: As you know
- ご{存|ぞん}じ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧: As you know
- ご{存|ぞん}じ⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: don't know (honorific negative)

KEIGO SYSTEM FOR ⟦{知|し}る→知る：00458_shiru⟧:
- ⟦{知|し}っている→知る：00458_shiru⟧: plain (about anyone)
- ご{存|ぞん}じ: honorific (about superiors, customers)
- ⟦{存|ぞん}じている→存じる：05912_zonjiru⟧ / ⟦{存|ぞん}じております→存じる：05912_zonjiru⟧: humble (about yourself, formal)

USAGE:
ご{存|ぞん}じ⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ is one of the most common keigo expressions in daily life. It is appropriate for speaking to customers, elders, or anyone you wish to show respect to.
